newsitem.title: USA: CME hog, pork belly futures close firmer on cash.
newsitem.headline: CME hog, pork belly futures close firmer on cash.

text.p: CME lean hog and pork belly futures held much of the early advance to close firmer on support sparked by stronger cash hog and pork markets Friday, traders said.
Hog futures closed 0.725 to 0.050 cent per lb higher with August up most at 81.450 cents. Pork bellies finished 0.975 cent a lb higher to 0.075 lower with August up 0.875 at 80.750 cents.

Gains in cash hog prices on Friday and expectations of advances again Monday teamed with higher wholesale pork prices to ignite commercial support in hog futures, traders said. Spillover demand from a late rally in live cattle futures also lent support ahead of the close, they said.

Market hog numbers remain tighter than expected and packers have been forced to pay higher prices despite a negative drop margin. An improvement in pork cutout values Thursday and a somewhat firmer product tone on Friday also encouraged ideas of higher cash hog prices Monday.

Rand Financials continued to buy August and October late with E.D.&F. Man also a buyer in August. Cargill Investor Services bought October and sold August, traders said. RBH bought August and sold October early.
Trading was thin in options with July volatility down sharply and August volatility weak, pit sources said.
